verdict.rationale: sevDesk documents bank-to-invoice mapping, missing-receipt visibility, and booking-category suggestions, but nothing shows an agent running a month-end reconciliation end-to-end, flagging exceptions, or preparing a close package for human review. The REST API and OpenAPI spec are developer building blocks an agent could be built on, not the capability itself, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can have an agent reconcile a month end-to-end, matching transactions, flagging exceptions, and preparing the close for human review
